Ajaymon, product designer

I’m Ajaymon, a product designer based in Bangalore. I turn complex fintech workflows into clear, intuitive experiences. At Karbon Business, I work on FlowTax, Forex and AI-powered accounting. Some of my favourite work is just below.

I started with freelance visual work , then data analysis at Mercedes-Benz R&D India and a UX internship at Skillto. That analytical background shapes how I approach design: understand the problem, clarify the details, and collaborate with developers.

These days, I spend my time strengthening design systems , exploring ideas in Figma and prototyping web and mobile experiences . I enjoy turning complicated requirements into interfaces that feel simple. I also make time to learn and experiment in my playground.
